pose: Extreme wide side profile. The Stegosaurus is rendered as a small character in the mid-ground to ensure absolute safety. Double row of dorsal plates and tail spikes held in a perfectly horizontal line. There must be 32% empty blue sky above the plates and 35% empty desert floor below the feet. All four feet must be clearly visible on the ground.

framing_presets.WIDE_WEIGHT_STRIP_V2: Extreme wide shot. The dinosaur is a small silhouette centered vertically. Distant desert mountains and a clear blue sky. Significant empty space at the very top and very bottom of the frame.
